skills.body:
# Month-end close
1. Reconcile every bank account for the period and clear unmatched lines.
2. Review open accruals and post any adjusting entries.
3. Run a trial balance and confirm debits equal credits.
4. Tick off the close checklist, then lock the period.
skills.description: Step-by-step month-end close for the finance team, from reconciliation to locking the period.
skills.name: month-end-close

skills.body:
# Bank reconciliation
Pull the statement lines that do not match a ledger entry. For each one, find the
missing or wrong entry, post an adjustment if needed, and rerun the match until the
unmatched list is empty.
skills.description: How to reconcile a bank statement against the general ledger and resolve differences.
skills.name: bank-reconciliation

skills.body:
# Refund a customer
Find the customer's charges for the period. Confirm the duplicate or disputed charge
with the customer. Refund only the duplicated amount, give a reason, and note the
refund on the ticket. Refunds over 5,000 need a manager's approval first.
skills.description: Policy and steps for refunding a customer, including partial refunds and duplicate charges.
skills.name: refund-a-customer

skills.body:
# Chargeback response
List open disputes and sort by deadline. For each, pull the invoice and the customer's
charges, attach proof of delivery, and submit before the deadline.
skills.description: How to answer a chargeback dispute before its evidence deadline.
skills.name: chargeback-response

skills.body:
# New hire onboarding
Once the offer is accepted, confirm the start date and manager, make sure the
employee record exists, order a laptop, and tell the team. Book a first-week
meeting with the manager.
skills.description: Checklist for onboarding a new hire, from accepted offer to first-day setup.
skills.name: new-hire-onboarding

skills.body:
# Interview loop
Pick four interviewers covering skills, values and the hiring manager. Schedule the
loop within a week, collect written feedback before the debrief, then advance or
reject the candidate.
skills.description: How to run a structured interview loop and collect feedback before a hiring decision.
skills.name: interview-loop

skills.body:
# Offboarding
List the leaver's devices and raise a ticket to revoke their application access.
Book the laptop and phone return for their last day and mark them returned once
they arrive.
skills.description: Steps for IT when an employee leaves, from revoking access to collecting their laptop.
skills.name: offboard-employee

skills.body:
# Laptop replacement
Check the warranty first. In warranty, send it for repair. Out of warranty, assign a
new laptop from stock and return the old one.
skills.description: How to replace a broken or out-of-warranty laptop.
skills.name: laptop-replacement

skills.body:
# Quote to close
Confirm the opportunity is at the proposal stage. Build the quote from the price list,
keep discounts within your limit or get approval, send it, and move the opportunity
to negotiation.
skills.description: How a sales rep takes a deal from qualified opportunity to a signed quote.
skills.name: quote-to-close

skills.body:
# Weekly pipeline review
Pull each rep's open opportunities, flag any past their close date, and agree the
quarter's forecast from the weighted pipeline.
skills.description: Agenda for the weekly sales pipeline review and forecast call.
skills.name: weekly-pipeline-review

skills.body:
# Restock low inventory
List items below their reorder point. If another warehouse has spare stock, transfer
it. Otherwise raise a purchase order to the preferred supplier.
skills.description: How the operations team restocks items that run low, by transfer or by purchase order.
skills.name: restock-low-inventory

skills.body:
# Late shipment follow-up
Track the shipment and check the carrier's latest event. If it is stuck, open a claim
with the carrier and email the customer a new delivery estimate.
skills.description: What to do when a delivery is late, from tracking to telling the customer.
skills.name: late-shipment-followup

skills.body:
# Rollback runbook
Open an incident first so on-call is paged. Check deployment history to find the last
good version, roll back, and confirm error rates recover before closing.
skills.description: Runbook for rolling back a deployment that broke production.
skills.name: bad-deploy-rollback

skills.body:
# Code review
Keep pull requests small. Request two reviewers, one from the owning team. Reviewers
answer within a working day. Merge only after approval and green checks.
skills.description: Team norms for requesting and giving code review on pull requests.
skills.name: code-review-etiquette

skills.body:
# Answer a support case
Read the case, search the knowledge base for an article that answers it, and reply
with the answer and a link. Escalate only if no article fits or the customer is blocked.
skills.description: How support agents answer a case using the knowledge base before escalating.
skills.name: answer-a-support-case

skills.body:
# SLA triage
List cases breaching within four hours. Reply or reassign each one, starting with the
highest priority.
skills.description: Morning triage of cases close to breaching their response-time target.
skills.name: sla-triage

skills.body:
# NDA request
Check whether an NDA with the counterparty already exists. If not, create one from
the standard template and send it for signature to both sides.
skills.description: How to get a standard NDA signed with a new partner or vendor.
skills.name: nda-request

skills.body:
# Data subject request
Log the request the day it arrives so the deadline starts. Find every processor that
holds the person's data and ask each one to act. Confirm to the requester within 30 days.
skills.description: Steps for handling a privacy request to access or delete someone's personal data.
skills.name: data-subject-request

skills.body:
# Launch an email campaign
Build or pick the segment and check its size. Create the campaign from an approved
template, send a test, then schedule it for a weekday morning.
skills.description: Checklist for launching an email campaign, from segment to scheduled send.
skills.name: launch-email-campaign

skills.body:
# Campaign retro
Pull opens, clicks and unsubscribes. Compare with the last three campaigns to the same
segment and note what to change.
skills.description: How to review a campaign's results and write up what to change next time.
skills.name: campaign-retro

skills.body:
# Generate Excel
Collect the rows, give each column a header, write the spreadsheet, and share it with
the people who asked for it.
skills.description: Turn tabular results into a formatted Excel spreadsheet and share it.
skills.name: generate-excel

skills.body:
# Status update
Three lines: what happened, what is next, what you need. Post it in the team channel
and email anyone outside the team who is waiting on it.
skills.description: How to write a short status update and post it to the right team channel.
skills.name: status-update

tasks.text: Close the books for October.
We need to finish month-end for September and lock it down so nobody posts into it.
Can you run the month-end close for last month?
Reconcile the operating bank account for August and tell me what doesn't match.
Which payments on the main bank statement haven't been booked yet this month?
Do a bank rec on account 1010 for Q3's last month.
Someone booked 4,200 of travel to office supplies in June. Move it to the travel account.
Find the entry that hit marketing instead of events last month and correct it.
Reclass the 950 consulting charge from account 6100 to 6300 for May.
Pull a trial balance for July.
Do debits and credits balance for the period ending 30 June?
I need the TB for last quarter's final month.
What's the closing balance on accounts receivable for September?
How much is sitting in the prepaid expenses account at the end of last month?
